item.title: Yu no Machi Hitozuma Kikou ~Onsen de Nure Nure Desu!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: GOKU-RAKU
  • 発売日: 2019-08-30
  • スコア: 6.36/10 (29 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ゆのまち人妻紀行 ～温泉で濡れ濡れです！～
  • 英語名: Yu no Machi Hitozuma Kikou Onsen de Nure Nure Desu!

あらすじ

A man visits a local hot spring resort to heal his mind and body after a hard day’s work.

There, he encounters a group of married women who are also on vacation, as well as a waitress who work at the inn.

Will you be able to communicate with them and get them to open their bodies to you? It all depends on you!

  • 日本語名: 上司の妻と部下の妻
  • 英語名: Joushi no Tsuma to Buka no Tsuma

あらすじ

I like to take other people’s women (things), I’ve been suppressing that proclivity for a long time because I had a bad experience because of it a long time ago…

But when I is transferred to a new job, and attractive married women appear around me, this proclivity rears its ugly head again.

item.title: Hitozuma ~Aishita Josei wa Hitozuma Deshita~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: GOKU-RAKU
  • 発売日: 2019-02-28
  • スコア: 6.33/10 (28 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ひとづま ～愛した女性は人妻でした～
  • 英語名: Hitozuma Aishita Josei wa Hitozuma Deshita

あらすじ

Meeting that woman was pure chance. From the moment I felt her kindness, I was drawn to her and fell in love.

But the next instant, my eyes caught the ring on her left ring finger, and my heart sank instantly.

Still, the human heart is unpredictable; there are parts that defy reason. Holding onto this feelings, I continued interacting with her. How exactly would our relationship change and develop?

item.title: Aniyome Oyako
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: GOKU-RAKU

  • スコア: 6.43/10 (60 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 兄嫁母妹
  • 英語名: Aniyome Oyako

あらすじ

The protagonist fails his entrance exams and moves to Tokyo to attend a prep school in the city, living with his brother’s family. His brother and sister-in-law warmly welcome him into their home. As he begins his new life, he becomes close to his kind sister-in-law, and his feelings for her begin to grow. Then, her mother and sister begin to visit as well…

item.title: Kon'ya no Otsumami ~Musuko-tachi no Yome wa Mitsu no Aji~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: GOKU-RAKU
  • 発売日: 2018-06-29
  • スコア: 6.7299999999999995/10 (31 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 今夜のお妻味 ～息子達の嫁は蜜の味～
  • 英語名: Kon’ya no Otsumami Musuko-tachi no Yome wa Mitsu no Aji

あらすじ

The main character has been living alone and has felt lonely ever since his wife passed away due to illness. One day, though, his luck completely changes.

His three sons have come back to live with him, each with his own wife. This is the start of a life full of temptation with his three gorgeous daughters-in-law!
